turns.text:
ok pasting a text from my sister, need to reply but my draft sounds like a robot wrote it

her text: "ok so the vendor stuff is getting out of hand. photographer, caterer, florist, dj, all want deposits and the april date is only 7 months away. i'm so behind. can you just tell me you'll help lol"

my draft: "Acknowledged. I will review the vendor options and provide a comparison. Please send the details at your earliest convenience."

Ha, yeah, that draft reads like an email from HR. Here's a warmer version:

"lol obviously i'll help. send me everything you've got on the photographer, caterer, florist and dj, quotes, deposit amounts, whatever's in your inbox. i'll put it all in one sheet so you can compare and stop stressing. april is closer than it feels but we've got time."

Want it a bit more teasing, or shorter?

lowkey good. can i add that i'll just handle th deadlines for th deposits too, she didnt ask for that but shes drowning. typing this from my phone btw, new battery today so it actually survives past 4 now

Nice, a phone that lasts past 4 p.m. is a real upgrade. Here's the version with the deposit deadlines:

"lol obviously i'll help. send me everything you've got on the photographer, caterer, florist and dj: quotes, deposit amounts, whatever's in your inbox. i'll put it all in one sheet so you can compare. and i'll track the deposit deadlines too so nothing sneaks up on you. you just pick the ones you like. april is closer than it feels but we've got this."

Offering the deadline tracking unprompted is a nice touch. It sounds like a brother, not a project manager.
thx. make it a bit shorter pls, she wont read a long text

Here's a tighter one:

"lol obviously i'll help. send me all the quotes and deposit amounts and i'll put them in one sheet. i'll keep track of the deadlines too so you don't have to. april's closer than it feels but we've got this."

If you want it even punchier, you could drop the last sentence.
